AuthError​

// Authentication error type
interface AuthError extends Error {
  code: (string & {}) | undefined; // Error code
  category: AuthErrorCategory; // Error category for business logic handling
  requestId?: string; // Request ID
  status: number | undefined; // HTTP Status Code
  helpMessage?: string; // Help message with error handling suggestions
  retryAfter?: number; // Seconds to wait before retrying after rate limiting
  loginMethodHint?: string; // Suggested sign-in method
  toJSON(): Record<string, unknown>; // Serializable error information
  // Common error codes
  // 400: Client Error
  // - invalid_argument: Invalid argument (incorrect email or phone number format)
  // - invalid_password: Invalid password format
  // - user_not_found: user does not exist
  // - already_exists: Email already exists
  // - phone_already_exists: Phone number already exists
  // - username_already_exists: Username already exists
  // - invalid_code: Invalid verification code
  // - code_expired: Captcha expired
  // - max_attempts_exceeded: Too many verification attempts
  // - password_too_weak: Password strength is insufficient
  // - invalid_token: Token invalid
  // - token_expired: Token expired
  // - state_mismatch: State parameter mismatch
  // - provider_not_supported: Unsupported third-party platform
  // - provider_mismatch: Third-party platform flag mismatch
  // - failed_precondition: Prerequisite failed
  // - permission_denied: Insufficient permissions
  // - resource_exhausted: Resource exhaustion
  // - unreachable: Network connection failed
  // - missing_required_param: Client missing a required param (e.g. standalone verifyOtp missing messageId)
  // - invalid_argument: Parameter error (verification code incorrect or expired, or invalid phone/email format)
  // - unimplemented: SMS/email channel not configured (server-side config error)
  // - not_found: User not found (verify phase)
  // - unauthenticated: Token verification failed
  // - unauthorized_client: Client verification failed
  // 500: Server Error
  // - internal_error: Internal Server Error
  // - service_unavailable: Service unavailable
}

// Error category enum
enum AuthErrorCategory {
  RATE_LIMITED = "RATE_LIMITED", // Rate limited
  CAPTCHA_REQUIRED = "CAPTCHA_REQUIRED", // Captcha required
  CAPTCHA_INVALID = "CAPTCHA_INVALID", // Captcha verification failed
  INVALID_CREDENTIALS = "INVALID_CREDENTIALS", // Invalid credentials (wrong password, Token expired, etc.)
  USER_NOT_FOUND = "USER_NOT_FOUND", // User not found
  INVALID_PARAMS = "INVALID_PARAMS", // Parameter format error
  PROVIDER_NOT_ENABLED = "PROVIDER_NOT_ENABLED", // Login method not enabled
  MFA_REQUIRED = "MFA_REQUIRED", // Multi-factor authentication required
  SERVICE_ERROR = "SERVICE_ERROR", // Server error
  NETWORK_ERROR = "NETWORK_ERROR", // Network unreachable
  PRECONDITION_FAILED = "PRECONDITION_FAILED", // Precondition not met (account already bound, etc.)
  VERIFICATION_FAILED = "VERIFICATION_FAILED", // Verification code check failed (expired/incorrect/mismatch)
  UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN", // Other uncategorized errors
}

CommonRes​

// Common response parameters
interface CommonRes {
  data: {}; // An empty object when successful
  error: AuthError | null; // error information, null if successful
}

  nickname?: string; // Nickname (optional)

// Password sign-in parameters
interface SignInWithPasswordCredentials {
  username?: string; // Username (optional; choose one of username, email, or phone)
  email?: string; // Email address (optional; choose one of username, email, or phone)
  phone?: string; // Phone number (optional; choose one of username, email, or phone)
  password: string; // Password (required)
  /** @deprecated Use options.is_encrypt instead. Kept for backward compatibility. */

    is_encrypt?: boolean; // Whether to encrypt transmission, defaults to false
    captchaToken?: string; // CAPTCHA token (optional)
  }
}

VerifyOtpParams​

/**
 * Params for standalone `auth.verifyOtp()`.
 *
 * **Required-ness differs**: `messageId` is required here.
 * On the `data.verifyOtp` callback from `signInWithOtp` / `signUp`, `messageId` is optional (already bound in the closure).
 * Prefer the callback so you do not forget the field.
 *
 * Standalone `auth.verifyOtp` only signs in; it does not register.
 */
interface VerifyOtpParams {
  type?:
    | "sms"
    | "phone_change"
    | "signup"
    | "invite"
    | "magiclink"
    | "recovery"
    | "email_change"
    | "email"; // OTP type (optional)
  email?: string; // Email (choose either this or phone)
  phone?: string; // Phone (choose either this or email)
  token: string; // Verification code (required)
  messageId: string; // Verification ID (required for standalone calls; optional on the callback)
}

  description?: string; // Description (optional)
  avatar_url?: string; // Avatar URL (optional). Must not exceed 200KB
  nickname?: string; // Nickname (optional)
  gender?: "MALE" | "FEMALE"; // Gender (optional)
}

AuthOtpResponse​

/**
 * Callback params received by `data.verifyOtp` from `signInWithOtp` / `signUp`.
 * The closure already binds email/phone and the send-time `messageId`; pass `token` only.
 *
 * **Required-ness differs**: `messageId` is optional on the callback; required for standalone `auth.verifyOtp(params)`.
 */
interface VerifyOtpCallbackParams {
  token: string | number; // Verification code (required)
  messageId?: string; // Optional override of the cached ID; usually omit
}

// OTP sign-in response
interface AuthOtpResponse {
  data: {
    /**
     * Verify the code and complete sign-in/sign-up. Pass `token` only; `messageId` is not required (SDK bound it).
     * Standalone `auth.verifyOtp` requires `messageId` and only signs in.
     */
    verifyOtp?: (params: VerifyOtpCallbackParams) => Promise<SignInRes>;
  };
  error: AuthError | null;
}

SignUpRes​

// User registration response
interface SignUpRes {
  data: {
    /**
     * Same callback as `signInWithOtp`: `messageId` is optional because the SDK bound it.
     */
    verifyOtp?: (params: VerifyOtpCallbackParams) => Promise<SignInRes>;
  };
  error: AuthError | null;
}

}

GetClaimsRes​

// Declaration information acquisition response parameter
interface GetClaimsRes {
  data: {
    // token declaration info
    claims?: {
      iss: string; // issuer
      sub: string; // subject
      aud: string; //  audience
      exp: number; //  expiration time
      iat: number; // issued at
      at_hash: string; // access token hash
      name: string; // Name
      picture?: string; // Avatar URL
      email?: string; // Email
      phone_number?: string; // Phone number
      scope: string; // Authorization scope
      project_id: string; // Project ID
      provider?: string; // Third-party platform flag
      provider_type?: string; // Third-party platform type
      groups?: string[]; // User group
      meta?: {
        wxOpenId?: string;
        wxUnionId?: string;
      };
      user_id: string; // uid
      roles: string[]; // role
      user_type: string; // Type of user
      client_type: string; // Client type
      is_system_admin: boolean; // System admin
    };
    // token header information
    header?: {
      alg: string; // Encryption algorithm
      kid: string; // Token ID
    };
    signature?: string; // Token signature
  };
  error: AuthError | null; // error information, null if successful
}

OnAuthStateChangeEvent​

// Authentication status change event type

  | "SIGNED_OUT" // User logged out
  | "SIGNED_IN" // User login successful
  | "INITIAL_SESSION" // Initial session established
  | "PASSWORD_RECOVERY" // Password reset
  | "TOKEN_REFRESHED" // Token refreshed
  | "USER_UPDATED" // User information updated
  | "BIND_IDENTITY"; // Identity source binding result

OnAuthStateChangeCallback​

  event: OnAuthStateChangeEvent,
  session: Session
) => void;
